name: stale-attachment-check
title: Stale Attachment Check
description: Prevents sending an old copy by checking each attachment against the files beside it (a newer save of the same file, report_v3_final.pdf edited today next to the attached report_v2.pdf), names that say draft, old, copy or (1), Office lock files and a file dated before the subject's date, with a one-tap swap to the newer file and Undo.

meta.stops: Old draft attached instead of final
